posts.ig_caption:
Read it twice. ✍️

Anaïs Nin understood something about writing that most people don’t — you don’t journal to record what happened, you journal to actually *live it*. Tonight’s prompt: describe a moment from the last month in as much sensory detail as you can remember. What did it feel like to be you in that moment? Save this and come back to it. ✨
